test_add_kernel: test the triton add_kernel that loads two input pointers and stores their element-wise sum to an output pointer
test_add_kernel_autotuned: test the triton add_kernel_autotuned with multiple block size and warp configurations for optimal kernel launch
test_add_kernel_2d_autotuned: test the triton add_kernel_2d_autotuned that performs element-wise addition on 2D matrices with strided indexing
test_mul2_kernel: test the triton mul2_kernel that multiplies each input element by two and stores the result
test_requires_cuda: test the requires_cuda decorator that skips tests when CUDA is not available
